note: Live seed for section 6, S5, in tests/live/run.sh, on tests/fixtures/repo-ui/: a required browser check fails while unit tests pass. run.sh applies tests/live/repo-ui-note.patch, the work the Executor entry reports, without committing it. The Executor calls AC2's 624px overflow pre-existing and logs completion anyway. Resuming spawns one squad-pm in ACCEPT mode, which must not PASS: its AC2 row reads not met in a FAIL, or not met: pre-existing in a pending entry that asks the user to waive or re-scope AC2. Each outcome below is a verdict appended to this seed: check 8a lints it, and check 8b holds tests/live/check_live.py's S5 judgment to its live value.

cites.text: Re-run yourself every verification command in the plan and the project's full test/verify commands (tests, typecheck, lint, build, scans); never trust logged claims.
PASS requires every row `met` or `waived`, apart from a later work order's `not checked` rows, and `Regressions: none`; any `not met` row or any regression is a FAIL.

Use `not met: pre-existing` only when the cause is in code this change did not touch and the same check fails the same way on the base commit; run it there (a temporary `git worktree` works) and cite that run.

A `not met: pre-existing` row is neither: append `## PM — Accept (pending)` with the block and a `BLOCKER:` block (`needs-human: waive or re-scope <ID>`), since only the user can release a locked criterion
Report completion only when every verification command the plan names passes.
A grant covers only the work orders it names: after their verdict, append a `## Status` and stop.
